description: Full-color emoji in Minecraft chat, signs, item names, and tooltips. Client-only Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2.

mods.name: Color Emoji
mods.description: Full-color emoji in chat, signs, item names, and other Minecraft text.

releases.notes:
Color Emoji for Minecraft **26.2**, Java **25**, and Fabric Loader **0.19.3 or newer**.

Download `color-emoji-1.0.0+26.2.jar`, put it in your client's `mods` folder, and restart Minecraft. Fabric API and server installation are not required.

- Full-color emoji in chat, signs, item names, and tooltips.
- Skin tones, flags, families, hearts, and keycaps render as single emoji.
- Plain text symbols keep Minecraft's appearance.
- Sent chat and sign text retain their original Unicode.

Built and verified in a real Minecraft client, including screenshots and outgoing-text checks.
